scope: Sweep allocation failures through a whole AC1027 DXF write containing long UTF-8 MTEXT, including a multibyte code point across the writer's 250-byte chunk boundary; verify rollback, same-codec retry, and typed readback.

source.profile: One MTEXT whose 552 UTF-8 bytes are 249 ASCII A bytes, a three-byte euro sign, and 300 ASCII B bytes; emitted as AC1027 ASCII and Binary. No external DWG/DXF fixture is used or added.

implementation.method: Add a dedicated fast mode to the whole-operation allocation harness. Calibrate the standalone generated MTEXT write in ASCII and Binary, inject one-shot allocation failures at every measured offset, verify destination sentinel and caller fields, then retry the same codec and require byte-identical output plus exact typed MTEXT readback.

validation.build: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dxf_write_allocation_transaction_tests --parallel 4: PASS; ASan target build: PASS
validation.directRun: PASS; long UTF-8 MTEXT: ASCII 101 and Binary 100 allocation offsets. Each failure preserved destination and caller entity; same-codec retry reproduced clean bytes and readback preserved exact UTF-8 text and modeled fields.

limitations: Generated transaction evidence for one long-text profile does not establish producer-authored prevalence, native line layout, font behavior, or rendering semantics.
No support claim is promoted and no drawing fixture is committed.
nextAction: Continue the P6-G public-writer inventory, keeping generated writer transaction evidence separate from independent semantic and consumer qualification.
